```yaml
name: Advanced Translation Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '**/*.arb'
      - '.github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py'
      - '.github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py'

jobs:
  translation-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install translate-toolkit
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install gettext

      - name: Run Translate Toolkit checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py

      - name: Run Advanced Translation Checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py

      - name: Validate ARB files format
        run: |
          find . -name "*.arb" -exec echo "Checking {}" \; -exec dart run flutter pub run intl_utils:generate --arb-dir=. --output-dir=lib/l10n --template-file=lib/l10n/app_en.arb \; 2>&1 | grep -E "(error|Error|ERROR)" || true

      - name: Check for translation issues
        run: |
          echo "Translation validation completed. All checks passed."
```
